# Patterns Library

Reusable stack-neutral content blocks for corpus files.

## For `README.md`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [code-evidence-table.md](./code-evidence-table.md) | **Required on every documented feature.** Where in the analysed system each claim comes from, cited as `path:line`. |
| [two-flow-table.md](./two-flow-table.md) | Two similar but distinct flows. |
| [legal-context-table.md](./legal-context-table.md) | Regulation, policy or contractual constraints. |
| [key-business-rules-summary.md](./key-business-rules-summary.md) | Short list of the most important rules. |
| [documentation-contents-table.md](./documentation-contents-table.md) | Scope checklist for a feature folder. |

## For `ARCHITECTURE.md`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [component-overview-block.md](./component-overview-block.md) | Fast orientation across components. |
| [components-table.md](./components-table.md) | Stack-neutral inventory of components/modules/files. |
| [db-schema-block.md](./db-schema-block.md) | Database or persisted structure documentation. |
| [data-mapping-table.md](./data-mapping-table.md) | Payload, form, event, file or database mapping. |
| [framework-config-block.md](./framework-config-block.md) | Verified framework/runtime configuration. |
| [consistency-boundaries-block.md](./consistency-boundaries-block.md) | Transactions, locks, retries, idempotency or compensation. |

## For `WORKFLOWS.md`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [mermaid-sequence-template.md](./mermaid-sequence-template.md) | Sequence diagram. |
| [state-machine-mermaid.md](./state-machine-mermaid.md) | State machine. |
| [transition-guard-table.md](./transition-guard-table.md) | Transition guards. |
| [error-paths-table.md](./error-paths-table.md) | Error paths and outcomes. |

## For `BUSINESS_RULES.md`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [business-rules-with-sources.md](./business-rules-with-sources.md) | Rules with IDs and sources. |
| [legal-framework-block.md](./legal-framework-block.md) | Laws, regulations or internal policies. |
| [deprecated-rules-table.md](./deprecated-rules-table.md) | Deprecated rules and replacements. |

## For `OPERATIONS.md` and `doc/prod/`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [incident-analysis-skeleton.md](./incident-analysis-skeleton.md) | Incident analysis structure. |
| [dynatrace-baseline-block.md](./dynatrace-baseline-block.md) | Observability baseline when Dynatrace is available. |
| [structural-risk-card.md](./structural-risk-card.md) | Structural risk card. |
| [common-issues-table.md](./common-issues-table.md) | Recurring symptoms and mitigations. |

## For `AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md`

| Pattern | When to use |
|---|---|
| [decision-tree-ascii.md](./decision-tree-ascii.md) | Branching operational guidance. |
| [safe-vs-dangerous-ops.md](./safe-vs-dangerous-ops.md) | Safe versus dangerous actions. |
| [roles-matrix.md](./roles-matrix.md) | Operation × role matrix. |
| [change-discipline-checklist.md](./change-discipline-checklist.md) | Files to update together. |
